description: This file contains Scala source code defining classes and objects related to Spark RDDs for R integration, including specialized RDD classes (BaseRRDD, PairwiseRRDD, RRDD, StringRRDD), Spark context creation, and socket-based data transfer for R data parallelization.

classes.name: BaseRRDD
classes.description: Abstract class for RDDs used in Spark R integration, handling computation with a runner and parent RDD.

classes.name: PairwiseRRDD
classes.description: RDD for key-value pairs with serialization, used in shuffle operations.

classes.name: RRDD
classes.description: RDD storing serialized R objects as Array[Byte].

classes.name: StringRRDD
classes.description: RDD storing R objects as Array[String].

classes.name: RRDD
classes.description: Companion object providing Spark context creation, RDD creation from arrays/files, and socket-based R data transfer.

classes.name: RParallelizeServer
classes.description: Socket server for parallelizing R data over network connections.

methods.name: createSparkContext
methods.description: Creates a JavaSparkContext with specified configuration, jars, and environment variables.

methods.name: createRDDFromArray
methods.description: Creates an RDD from an array of byte arrays, used for R parallelization.

methods.name: createRDDFromFile
methods.description: Creates an RDD from a file, used for large R objects.

methods.name: serveToStream
methods.description: Serves data over a socket stream with authentication, used for R data transfer.
